name: Cost Estimates
excerpt: Cost Estimates are predictions of the costs involved in completing project activities.
notes: Cost Estimates can be derived using various methods such as analogous estimates, bottom-up estimates, and parametric modeling. These estimates help in creating a cost baseline and are essential for budgeting and financial planning.
context_summary:
- Predictions of costs for completing project activities.
- Derived using methods like analogous estimates and bottom-up estimates.
- Essential for budgeting and financial planning.
